simple: A plug-in for the VS Code, Visual Studio, Eclipse and IntelliJ development environments: checks code (including AI-written code), third-party libraries, APIs and infrastructure as code right while it is written — with rapid code and component scans or a full Coverity scan. The Black Duck Assist AI assistant explains a finding and suggests a fix. Sold separately per developer or included with Coverity, Black Duck SCA, Software Risk Manager or Polaris. Black Duck is the former Synopsys Software Integrity Group, an independent company since October 2024.
